title: Show HN: TikTok but for scientific papers
summary: A web platform that presents scientific papers in a TikTok-style vertical scrolling interface, making academic research discovery more engaging and accessible through short-form content presentation.
problem_solved: Transforms the tedious experience of discovering and browsing academic papers into an addictive, swipe-based interface similar to social media platforms.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to scientific research by presenting complex papers in an engaging, user-friendly format that appeals to younger generations accustomed to short-form content.
